# Independent review: source route comparison

Reviewed candidate: `REPORT_2026-09-15_SOURCE_ROUTE_COMPARISON.md`  
SHA256: `930d5d134cc5631c2df91afa5ffb9b4ac87a7e48260561be10f65e604454310f`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_SCOPED_RATE_MINIMUM_CURVATURE_COMPARISON_ONLY.**

R1--R2 correctly generalize the Prékopa factorization to arbitrary finite
positive shape-two Gamma rates.  Equal minimal rates leave zero coefficients
in the concave logarithmic integrand and cause no failure; their polynomial
multiplicity is paid in the endpoint tails used for integration by parts.
Thus the curvature and tilted-variance/modulus bounds depend only on the
minimum rate for this proof.

R3 is correctly normalized: equal rates give a constant multiple of
`exp(-lambda cosh(2x))`, so its normalized transform is the same Bessel
model for every N.  This is not an xi approximation.  The report correctly
distinguishes dependence of this particular proof from a claim that every
possible proof must use square rate spacing.  It adds no C6-all-R, V, or RH
claim.

result: Prékopa gamma curvature proof extends to arbitrary finite positive shape-two gamma rates, including tied minima; depends only on minimal rate
Equal-rate geometric symmetrization yields the same normalized Bessel source for every N
Exact square rate spacing and full reciprocity have not supplied the remaining zero-cancellation proof
retained_route_status: Direct Barvinok implementations parked after two bounded preflights; geometric central slab retained; arithmetic reconstruction retained as alternative
